answer: Stake bonds at the forge: each identity locks 5000 tokens, slashed 100% on proven duplication. Velvet latency (~200ms) lets validators cross-check attestations before finality, so a farm of n identities needs n×5000 collateral at risk. Collusion drives returns to the nadir once slashing exceeds 30% of bonded stake. Attacker cost scales linearly, honest latency stays sub-second, so forgery is unprofitable.
